design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (age 42, 1-hour dull frontal headache tonight, and enclosed residential garage portable gasoline generator exposure) with a 2-word span difference (22 vs 24 words) and zero diagnosis labels ('carbon monoxide' omitted from prompt texts). Under Rule A and Rule D, keeping the exact same 42-year-old homeowner and 1-hour dull forehead headache tonight while replacing only the preceding home exposure in f3 with staring at laptop spreadsheets shifts right care cleanly from ER (level 4) to home self-care (level 1) with zero residual CO suspicion and zero stated negatives.
